title: Care Level Determination Standard — Assisted Living Care Levels 1 to 6
content:
**Wellness Department standard for the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.**

**Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause reading "the care level of a resident is always the level whose care-point band contains the care points of the most recent assessment; there is no discretionary level and the level billed never differs from the band of the latest assessment once its effective date has passed" is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis.

**Clauses in force.**

1. Each assessment records the care points, the indicated level and whether that level differs from the level billed on the assessment date.
2. An assessment score above the highest score of the highest care level, or a wander or exit-seeking risk where such a risk is excluded from assisted living, means the resident's needs exceed assisted living. The level is not changed, and the residency proceeds to an ending for discharge because needs exceed assisted living, or for transfer to memory care, under the move-out terms.
3. Assessments and level changes may be recorded only while the residency is in pending admission, active, on leave or notice given status.

### Input — judgement — output (hypothetical assessments)

| Assessment finding | Judgement | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Score 42, level billed Assisted Living Care Level 2 | Indicated level differs from the level billed | Recorded with indicated level Assisted Living Care Level 3 and a level difference marked |
| Score 104 | Above the highest score of the highest level | Level not changed; ending for discharge (needs exceed assisted living) or transfer to memory care |
| Wander risk identified | Wander risk excludes assisted living | Level not changed; same ending as above |
| Any score, residency in vacated status | Status outside those permitted | Not recorded |

superseded_clauses: The care level of a resident is always the level whose care_points_min to care_points_max band contains the care points of the most recent assessment; there is no discretionary level and the level billed never differs from the band of the latest assessment once its effective date has passed.
